title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23-year-old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five-year-old boys in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. The knife blade was about 8.5 centimetres long. One boy had a neck vein severed and needed emergency surgery, another suffered chest wounds that damaged his heart and nearly died, and the third was hurt on his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, so he dropped the knife and surrendered, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say he planned for weeks, using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and choosing children as targets. He bought clothes and kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and purchased raw beef to practise stabbing. He acted on China's National Day and posted patriotic messages online shortly before. The prosecution calls the act cold-blooded and motivated by revenge, a need for recognition, and ideological delusion. They demand a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion order. The court hearing began on Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
